T13 re-derivation (2026-09-10, permissive reading, §10.2.1): smoothing_route is cationic_alignment on a two-observation SFR-high read (film: Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride r5; lubrication: Dicaprylyl Ether r4), clearing §7.4.1's two-observation test. COND high was over-satisfied (the LGN pair r2/r7/r8 alone would have carried it), so under the conservative reading the film route read as baseline conditioning; under the now-adopted permissive reading, a single admissible establishing set (the LGN pair) suffices to leave the cationic film beyond baseline. Every other route fails its own gate (curl_definition: HOLD none; heat_styling: HEAT not_claimed; detangling: no C1/C2 positioning and COND/WT both too high; volume_lightness: WT high; shine: would restate the smoothing film, G3).
